summary: Initializes BVH tree node array state: zeroes the node-count field at offset 0xC84, clears 256 entries of the dword array at offset 0x87C plus a parallel byte array during one loop, zeroes 48 bytes (0x30) at this+802, and returns 0. No conditional branches.

256-iteration loop clearing one byte entry at (this + 892 + i) and one dword entry through the cursor starting at offset 0x87C (this[543]).
Zero 48 bytes (0x30) starting at this + 802 via memset.
